218.title: The Terminator
218.overview: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

51610.title: The Wild Soccer Bunch 5
51610.overview: "The Wild Soccer Bunch" celebrate their last victory against the "Silver Lights" - and set one record in volley-pass game after another in the forest. But they are not alone: Vampires target the team. To lure them into their bunker, they kidnap Leon. Will Vanessa ever see him again?

372058.title: Your Name.
372058.overview: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.

445466.title: Idiots
445466.overview: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

464154.title: One Piece: Jango's Dance Carnival
464154.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates visit Mirrorball Island. Where a big dance carnival is being held. Jango the Hypnotist was there too, to show off his dance moves. Only when he was found by a group of Marines who were about to arrest him. But ended up chasing him throughout the island. Our heroes got involved when one of the Marines recognized Luffy from the wanted poster. And they end up getting chased as well. Soon Jango steals the spotlight of the dance carnival and uses his hypnosis on everyone on the island. And soon everyone including Jango, The StrawHat Pirates, and the marines are all dancing like there's no tomorrow.
464154.original_title: ONE PIECE ジャンゴのダンスカーニバル

772506.title: Love is Love
772506.overview: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.
772506.trailerName: Love is love | Official Trailer New HULU

849178.title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs. The Amazonistas of Planet X
849178.overview: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.
849178.trailerName: Zsazsa Zaturnnah Vs The Amazonistas Of Planet X - Teaser

1036954.title: To the Victory!
1036954.overview: A dystopian story set in post-war Ukraine, where a frustrated film director struggles to make the most of his life after being denied the opportunity to pursue his movie-making career. Estranged from his wife and daughter, who have been living in Vienna and are reluctant to return to their war-torn nation, the director tries to find solace in his conviction that the difficult times will pass and life will return to normal.

1074074.title: The Beloved
1074074.overview: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

1198746.title: Above the Below
1198746.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

1228314.title: Stiletto
1228314.overview: A year after the grisly murder of a local exotic dancer, the victim’s sister, Lyric, searches for the serial killer responsible as he stalks and kills his favorite dancers on the night of the anniversary.

1249562.title: Muito Prazer
1249562.overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

1253786.title: Westhampton
1253786.overview: Haunted by an accident he caused in high school, a damaged filmmaker is forced to go back to the scene of the tragedy and face the friends whose lives he ruined and a town that disdains him. Jumping between the present and an indie film he made about the accident reveals how the true events played out far differently than depicted in his movie.

1262426.title: Tinā
1262426.overview: A woman grieving her daughter's death in the Christchurch earthquakes, becomes a substitute teacher at an elite private school. Unexpectedly, she discovers students lacking guidance and care, prompting her to provide inspiration and support.

1273690.title: The Wizard of the Emerald City, Part II
1273690.overview: The heroes journey to the Purple Country and confront the witch Bastinda.
1273690.original_title: Волшебник Изумрудного города. Великий и ужасный

1283994.title: WOLF
1283994.overview: Tilda Swinton guides us through the life of cult British musician Patrick Wolf, weaving together archive and animation to illuminate a singular artistic journey.

1284186.title: Sacrifice
1284186.overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

1287322.title: Christy
1287322.overview: Christy Martin never imagined life beyond her small-town roots in West Virginia—until she discovered a knack for punching people. Fueled by grit, raw determination, and an unshakable desire to win, she charges into the world of boxing under the guidance of her trainer and manager-turned-husband, Jim. But while Christy flaunts a fiery persona in the ring, her toughest battles unfold outside it—confronting family, identity, and a relationship that just might become life-or-death.

1327450.title: If I Tell You
1327450.overview: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

1352026.title: National Theatre Live: The Importance of Being Earnest
1352026.overview: Being sensible can be excessively boring. At least Jack thinks so. While assuming the role of dutiful guardian in the country, he lets loose in town under a false identity. Meanwhile, his friend Algy takes on a similar facade. Unfortunately, living a double life has its drawbacks, especially when it comes to love. Hoping to impress two eligible ladies, the gentlemen find themselves caught in a web of lies they must carefully navigate.
1352026.trailerName: The Importance Of Being Earnest | Official Trailer | National Theatre Live
1352026.original_title: National Theatre Live: The Importance of Being Earnest

1361562.title: Summer's Camera
1361562.overview: After her father passed away, Summer stopped taking photos. One day, she falls for Yeonwoo, the school's soccer star, and takes her picture with her late father's camera. When she develops the film, she finds mysterious photos of her father's high school lover. In these photos, Summer uncovers a secret about her father. Will she be able to pursue her first love and uncover her father's hidden truth?

1367642.title: Reminders of Him
1367642.overview: When Diem's custodial grandparents adamantly refuse Kenna's attempts to see her daughter, Kenna discovers unexpected compassion, and then something truer and deeper, with former NFL player and local bar owner Ledger. As their secret romance develops, so do the dangers for both of them, leading Kenna toward heartbreak and, ultimately, the hope for a second chance.

1389146.title: Ranger
1389146.overview: Based on the novel by Aseem Arora.

1389210.title: The Double
1389210.overview: A short film adapted from one of Fyodor Dostoevsky novels: "The Double";Directed by Youssef Askar set to be released in 2026.

1391450.title: I Fell, It's Fine
1391450.overview: When Anne, a guarded wellness-resort owner, meets an otherworldly woman named Chicks, her carefully controlled life begins to unravel in the most healing way.
1391450.trailerName: 'I Fell, It's Fine' Official Trailer | Glaiza De Castro and Rhian Ramos

1398298.title: Mother's Day
1398298.overview: In a tiny Indigenous Mexican town where everyone is family, a secret pregnancy tests the forbidden love between two cousins. During the vibrant Mother’s Day festival, a public dance becomes a bold act of defiance that will change their lives forever.

1410202.title: A Stroll to Syracuse
1410202.overview: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

1421594.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
1421594.overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

1432474.title: Nimrods
1432474.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

1434586.title: Trapped in the Spotlight
1434586.overview: Neveah, a canceled R&B singer, struggles to rebuild her career and regain her fame 15 years after breaking up with her estranged co-star, Lupita, who publicly betrayed her.

1438874.title: Secrets of the Southwest
1438874.overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

1441306.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
1441306.overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

1454106.title: Somnambule
1454106.overview: Adam is a sleepwalker: as soon as he falls asleep, his personality completely changes... and he does crazy things. One morning, upon waking up, he sees Estelle, his boss's daughter, tied up in his bathroom. He has no memory of what happened. Pursued by the police, he must solve this mystery to avoid ending up in prison.

1458202.title: L'incasable
1458202.overview: Humiliated by feeling rejected yet again, 14-year-old Solal gets into a fight with Thomas, a counselor at his home. Joris, his 10-year-old roommate, fascinated by Solal, has no intention of letting him go.

1465818.title: Horsegirls
1465818.overview: As her mother battles an uncertain diagnosis, neurodivergent 22-year-old Margarita discovers a source of strength in an unexpected place: the sport of hobbyhorsing.

1468698.title: King & Jester: Forever
1468698.overview: The punk universe of "King & Jester" is threatened with destruction. The fairy-tale world is collapsing under the footsteps of the dead, resurrected by the mad Necromancer. No one can defeat the villain except his creators - friends separated by death... Gorshok and Knyaz.

1473370.title: Erie
1473370.overview: Siblings Stella and Oscar return to their Pennsylvania hometown to investigate their sister Iris' unexplained death following a mysterious rise in suicides within the county.

1477082.title: Para Vigo Me Voy!
1477082.overview: A Documentary about the Brazilian Filmmaker Carlos Diegues and His Works.

1481626.title: Love Kills
1481626.overview: In downtown São Paulo, absolutely ravaged by crack cocaine, Helena, a young black vampire, wanders around a filthy café trying to captivate Marcos, a naive waiter. As she begins to discover his secrets and the ins and outs of the metropolis, the girl will go on to venture into a dangerous world of immortal intrigues that will challenge her own mortality.

1481690.title: Mouse
1481690.overview: When a lonely petty thief begins a correspondence with the woman of his dreams, two competing fantasies collide in an unexpectedly human story about loneliness, class, and the desperate need to belong.

1481946.title: Thinestra
1481946.overview: A young woman takes a new weight-loss pill and the fat she sheds returns in the form of her blood-thirsty doppelgänger.

1486426.title: A Bloody Mess
1486426.overview: A true-crime documentarian and her trusty crew investigate a small-town tragedy that’s faded into memory as a national joke. As her determination to uncover the truth becomes more and more intense, her methods become less and less ethical—until they become dangerous.

1492890.title: 20, Livid
1492890.overview: Len is a 20 year old college freshman with the desire to be an artist and go see the world. The only problem is that she is stuck in a college dorm room with no clear path to the future. With the help of her best friend, Annie, she must navigate her way through the early stages of adulthood by dealing with her relationship, living out her dream, and the emotional toll that it all entails.

1497946.title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
1497946.overview: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.
1497946.original_title: ネルソンさん、あなたは人を殺しましたか？

1498522.title: Behind Closed Doors
1498522.overview: Marie, a young doctor, experienced a miscarriage four months ago. Unable to grieve, the marriage to her French husband Jude starts to break apart. But when her parents pay them an unexpected visit, the world which Marie has built for herself so carefully starts to crumble.

1499546.title: It will happen tonight
1499546.overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

1500890.title: Lockbox
1500890.overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled, enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

1501018.title: A Family of Bastards
1501018.overview: After the death of his father, Mohamed discovers the living of a step-brother and a step-sister. Together, they must manage the suspicious bar they inherited of linked to criminality, drug traffic and prostitution.

1511386.title: The Old Genie
1511386.overview: Moscow schoolboy Volodya accidentally fishes out of the Moscow River a mysterious lamp, from which the genie Khottabych appears. He promises to fulfill any of his wishes, but each of them turns into unexpected consequences. Magic multiplies, rather than solves Volodya's problems. Nevertheless, the schoolboy is imbued with the genie's problems and, as a result, finds himself in the past, where Khottabych's daughter marries an unloved man. Trying to destroy this marriage and free Khottabych, Volodya and his friends go to an ancient Eastern wedding.

1512346.title: The Death of Time as We Know It
1512346.overview: Daisy finds a mysterious amulet which she believes is altering her perception of time.
1512346.trailerName: The Death of Time as We Know It - Trailer 2
1512346.original_title: The Death of Time as We Know It

1516698.title: The Last Sunrise
1516698.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

1526874.title: Samurai Ballerina -L'étoile de Paris en fleur-
1526874.overview: Paris in the early 20th century. Fujiko dreams of becoming a painter despite expectations of marriage, while Chizuru, born into a samurai family, longs to study ballet. Reunited in Paris after meeting as children, they support each other and move toward their dreams.

1533274.title: Four Girls
1533274.overview: Finding shelter in an abandoned mansion, a group faces the challenges of coexistence. Free from traditional power structures, the black women experience power, love, and the possibility of dreaming about the future, while the white women resist learning to help with household chores, take care of themselves, and face their mistakes. When an old threat resurfaces, however, they all must band together to survive.

1535066.title: Mother of a Son
1535066.overview: A year after her son’s act of violence, a mother comes to terms with his actions, caught between unconditional love and the weight of his terrible legacy.

1535130.title: Kylie: Tension Tour Live
1535130.overview: It's time to hit the dancefloor as pop superstar Kylie Minogue shares a vibrant, exclusive behind-the-scenes look at her smash 2025 Tension World Tour.

1537690.title: Busted Water Pipes
1537690.overview: A crime-fighting cop maintains a zero-crime rate and faces job loss, so he decides to fabricate a major case, unaware that actual grave robbers are targeting a treasure-filled tomb located directly beneath his police station.
1537690.trailerName: BUSTED WATER PIPES (BAO SHUI GUAN) 爆水管 - Opens January 30th in select Canadian & US theaters!

1545690.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
1545690.overview: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

1551002.title: Il n'y aura jamais assez d'images
1551002.original_title: Il n'y aura jamais assez d'images

1554138.title: Crazy Christmas
1554138.overview: The Serediuk household in Yablunivka sits nigh empty and its proud patriarch Vasyl Serediuk decides that, to end his loneleyness, he'll have to resort to drastic measures, faking a chronic condition and inviting all of his friends and family members over for "one last mutual Christmas". But, his lies might end up costing him his family.

1555226.title: Echoes of Motherhood
1555226.overview: The love and conflicts between mother and daughter, and between husband and wife. The final chapter of Nakagawa Ryutaro's trilogy, depicting the forms of love that endure through loss and rebirth.

1558682.title: Daddy Is A Hunter
1558682.overview: A school counselor meets with a troubled student where he learns about the boy's intense at-home life, his father's late night desertions, and the monstrous secret beneath it all.

1569050.title: Rider
1569050.overview: Saluele, known as Sami, is a young fiid delivery rider who spends his days cycling across Milan travelling from one end of the city to the other. On New Year's Eve, while the city bursts into celebration, beneath dazzling lights, he delivers a huge sushi order to a luxorious villa on the city's northern outskirts. Invited to stay for the evening, Sami meets Nia, and the two instantly form a powerful connection. But as a new romance begins to blossom, an impulsive decision will have fatal consequences, forcing Sami to decide whether to face the consequences of his actions.

1573018.title: In The Shadow of a High Rise Flat
1573018.overview: Deirdre and Jim meet in secret, again. They wander the evening streets of Glasgow pondering life, love and their future but there is a secret being kept that will change their relationship forever.
1573018.original_title: In The Shadow of a High Rise Flat

1577498.title: Después de Kim
1577498.overview: Juan and Gloria, divorced and estranged for 20 years, must travel from Buenos Aires to Spain upon receiving the news that Kim, their daughter with whom they lost contact long ago, has been found dead. Upon arrival, they discover that the deceased has left behind a grandson whose whereabouts are unknown, a discovery that compels them to stay in Spain to find him.

1591834.title: Familia a la deriva
1591834.overview: To make up for lost time with his four children, a charismatic car salesman organizes a Caribbean yacht trip that quickly spirals into an out-of-control adventure filled with mix-ups, laughs, and second chances.

1596314.title: Give Me the Ball!
1596314.overview: World champion tennis trailblazer Billie Jean King has had a game-changing impact on culture and sports. Rare archive and candid interviews with Billie Jean and those closest to her reveal how one woman put changing the world ahead of saving herself.

1599770.title: Bucks Harbor
1599770.overview: Boys in Downeast Maine are shaped by the brutal winters, their harvesting of the ocean’s bounty and the rigid codes of their fathers. Bucks Harbor explores growing up in a community where a man’s worth is often defined by the strength of his back.

1611738.title: Spiral
1611738.overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

1614234.title: Some Kind of Refuge
1614234.overview: On the shifting edge of the Mississippi River in New Orleans, the spirit of a fading outsider community endures through its two oldest residents.

1616794.title: The Moths & the Flame
1616794.overview: In Pahokee, Florida, the myth of the absent Black father is contradicted every day: housework, children’s birthdays, neighbourhood, care. In vignettes brimming with solidarity, Contento traces out his protagonists’ self-confidence. Calm and attentive.

1619290.title: Emperor
1619290.overview: After taking a deserted Moscow, Napoleon occupies the Kremlin, where his loyal General Michel Clément, a descendant of a Russian boyar who came to Russia believing in the justice of Napoleon's campaign, constantly stands by his side. Meanwhile, the monks of the Chudov Monastery plot to assassinate the emperor by mining the Arsenal, and the young noblewoman Maria, seeking revenge for her dead brother, attempts to shoot Napoleon. The failed assassination attempt brings her into contact with Michel and the Polish officer Józef Sadok. Disguised as an actress in the monastery, Maria finds herself drawn into a dangerous game where rescue, suspicion, and a budding bond with Michel gradually change the fates of all involved.

1623002.title: Artemis II - Zurück zum Mond
1623002.overview: For the first time since the legendary Apollo missions over 50 years ago, humans are once again setting out for the Moon on April 1, 2026. NASA’s Artemis II mission marks the beginning of a new era in space exploration, and Germany will play a key role. This documentary follows the four astronauts during their preparations and offers exclusive insights into the Orion spacecraft. German astronauts Alexander Gerst and Matthias Maurer, along with other space experts, explain how the mission will proceed and why it is being undertaken. It's a journey that blends science, adventure, and the fundamental question: Why do people risk their lives to reach other celestial bodies and distant worlds?

1626202.title: R
1626202.overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

1628826.title: Creation
1628826.overview: The Hungarian word "alkotás" (artwork) has a dual meaning – it can refer both to the process of creation and to the finished artwork. The film tells the story of how a canvas comes alive, how playful, abstract forms are created, each one carrying its own human narrative.

1636186.title: Seven Versts Before Dawn
1636186.overview: In the early days of the Great Patriotic War old Kuzmich from the village of Kurakino guesses that a long war lies ahead. As the village falls under German occupation and repressions intensify, he keeps aloof, arousing suspicions. Following the execution of fellow villagers and accusations of betrayal, Kuzmich agrees to serve as a guide for the German detachment, ostensibly to get a horse and save his family. In reality, however, he is planning a sacrificial deception: through his grandson Vaska, he conveys information about the enemy's route to the Soviet troops. At the critical moment, Kuzmich leads the German mountain troopers into a trap, repeating the feat of Ivan Susanin. At the cost of his own life the old man leads the enemy to perdition, becoming a symbol of the people's resistance.

1636890.title: Window Shopper
1636890.overview: A photographer finds a mannequin abandoned on the street during one of his night shoots. After deciding to remove her limbs and take them with him to use in his photos, he becomes hunted by the mannequin herself. A surreal chase unfolds on a night in which curiosity always triumphs over fear.

1638874.title: The Catastrophe
1638874.overview: Masa has a problem. The nearest parcel locker is far away, and it's about to close. His girlfriend on the phone wants him to pick up her new shoes and Masa is determined not to disappoint her. Fresh from his own metal gig, Masa presses the gas pedal a bit too hard and fails to notice a black cat crossing the road. The crash is unavoidable. He drags the deceased cat into a nearby yard but a sharp-eyed elderly lady catches him in the act.

1650906.title: Angel
1650906.overview: When a sex worker is consumed by the life of drugs and partying, accidentally overdosing, she embarks on a journey to better her life.

1651162.title: The Mountain
1651162.overview: The story begins when Kazuno receives a letter from an old friend. The letter says that ever since a group of them tested their courage at an abandoned ruin, a series of strange and disturbing events has begun to occur. Half out of curiosity as part of her research, Kazuno visits the people involved. However, what awaits her is only the beginning of days filled with terror that will eventually consume her as well. One of them dies under mysterious circumstances, and the remaining survivors gradually begin to lose their sanity.

1654426.title: Lungi man
1654426.overview: A movie with socio fantasy elements

1655898.title: Три кота. Вокруг света
1655898.overview: Continuation of the adventures of Korzhik, Karamelka and Kompot.

1659034.title: Motherhood
1659034.overview: From childhood onward, rules are imposed on us, behaviours are dictated to us, and we are told “how to live,” but we are never prepared for the difficulty of “being.” This film explores this question through the lens of motherhood.

1659162.title: Downtown
1659162.overview: In 1988, three young gay men, Ronnie, Lennart and Bas, throw themselves into Amsterdam's nightlife  scene. It’s a life full of friendship, sex and drugs. Until the mysterious AIDS virus casts a shadow over their  lives and one of them disappears after becoming infected. Thirty-two years later, in the middle of the 2021  lockdown, Ronnie recognises the missing Bas in the subway. An evening unfolds that none of them had  expected to see, but which had been in the air for years. The AIDS epidemic has had a major impact on all  three of their lives. Where they lost each other 32 years ago, they hope to find each other again.

1660570.title: Maybe We Were Fire
1660570.overview: Danny and Eve -- two high school sweethearts who tied the knot just shy at 18, suddenly find themselves at a crossroads when they suddenly separate 10 years later. Now, the once inspeparable couple must navigate a life without each other while their friends, family, and acquaintances are all caught in the middle. Flashbacks detailing their relationship follow.

1660890.title: HIM+
1660890.overview: Chris is a young Black man whose life takes a drastic turn when he learns he is HIV positive. Struggling with fear, stigma, and uncertainty, Chris is forced to confront himself and the world around him in a new way. Through the support of his faith, friends, and mentor, he begins to discover strength and resilience he didn’t know he had.

1661850.title: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Apr.
1661850.overview: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Apr. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on April 8, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

1675994.title: French Girls
1675994.overview: A young woman enters the uniquely absurd world of modelling in this Sydney microbudget marvel. The debut feature of Hyun Lee.  Mia is drifting through life working on construction sites when she’s scouted by a Sydney model agent. Suddenly, she’s making more money than ever while working less – something her boyfriend loves to point out. Mia quietly observes this strange new world of modelling with deep uncertainty. Is this really the life she wants? With one curious turn after another, she finds herself in trouble with the law.

1676506.title: Mexicanamerican
1676506.overview: Expertly merging old VHS home movies with new family interviews, filmmaker Eddie Sánchez traces his parents' journey from Mexico to the U.S. in this poignant and affecting documentary debut.
1676506.trailerName: Mexicanamerican | Official Trailer | Tribeca Festival World Premiere 2026

1678554.title: Christmas Spirit
1678554.overview: On Christmas Eve, worried Santa won't be able to see his house, a boy and his grandfather plot a holiday decoration heist.

1687130.title: Tomb Quest
1687130.overview: In a suburban basement, five old friends meet on the night of their friend's funeral to fulfill his final request: finish the Tomb Quest role-playing campaign they abandoned after their high school graduation.
1687130.trailerName: New Musical Kickstarting Soon... TOMB QUEST!

1687834.title: TRENTE
1687834.overview: An intimate documentary exploring the transition into one's thirties-a time of questioning in a world evolving faster than the one we grew up in. Seb discovers old footage from his youth and confronts past dreams with present reality.

1688666.title: 1995 - Hopes and Betrayals
1688666.overview: In 1995, Quebec faced a harrowing choice: remain part of Canada or establish itself as a separate country. The future of a nation and a lifelong dream were at stake in this referendum. Through interviews and analysis, journalists Antoine Robitaille and Dave Noël delve into the secret strategies, fierce rivalries, and political maneuvering of both sides.

1688858.title: Harvey & Maude
1688858.overview: For years, Maude has remained housebound, her home a refuge from a world that feels both hostile and alien. Meanwhile, Harvey —a long-forgotten imaginary friend— wanders aimlessly through a realm of the unremembered. Though worlds apart, their paths are destined to cross, and their lives begin to brighten as they realize that imagination hasn't faded quite yet.

1691418.title: For Those Who Love, Leave, and Love Again
1691418.overview: Haunted by the memory of an absent, violent father, Paul moves restlessly through Berlin’s night, drifting into fleeting encounters that only deepen his loneliness.
1691418.original_title: For Those Who Love, Leave, and Love Again

1691994.title: Break Room
1691994.overview: BREAK ROOM is a single-location ensemble comedy set entirely within the break room of SMA, Inc., a generic American corporation. The piece unfolds in real time across one frenetic morning, as a rotating cast of coworkers cycles through the room — grabbing coffee, heating lunches, arguing, commiserating, philosophizing, and repeatedly losing money to a broken vending machine.

1692250.title: Corn
1692250.overview: After getting a promotion, Dennis gets invited to his boss's house for dinner, which turns into a living nightmare when Dennis eats corn the "wrong" way.

1693274.title: 100 Dates in Dallas

1693914.title: Kushti
1693914.overview: A touching comedy-drama about a wrestling-loving couple torn by clashing personalities. They can't live together, yet can't stay apart. This story is a humorous, emotional journey of love, struggle, and deep connection.

1694426.title: The Hockey Player
1694426.overview: A documentary that follows Canadian-born defenseman Luke Prokop as he decides to become the first — and still only — professional athlete playing under contract to an NHL team to come out as gay. Growing up in Edmonton steeped in Canada’s tough, often homophobic hockey culture, and playing without gay role models throughout professional sports, Luke’s path to coming out of the closet has been neither easy nor obvious. The film charts Prokop’s personal journey against the backdrop of a professional hockey industry that has had, at best, an ambivalent relationship to diversity. As the film sensitively reveals, being publicly out certainly came as an earthquake to his family, especially his father Al, who as Luke’s mentor and sometime coach represents the most complex and moving relationship in the film.

1696218.title: A Short Film About War
1696218.overview: Fahed, a Palestinian, has been studying film directing in Poland for several years. He is learning the ropes on the set of a production about the Second World War. For the time being, he is working as a sound technician’s assistant, but he soon gets the chance to take on a slightly different role. Although it is an unconventional choice, the young man agrees to play the role of a Nazi.

1699034.title: Coming of Age
1699034.overview: In today’s harsh world, where it’s hard to live even if you want to work, Jae-soon, who struggles to get through each day without any preparation for the future, has a dream. It is to share three warm meals a day with her daughter in a safe and stable home. To prepare a coming-of-age gift for her daughter, Su-min, she sells pieces of her own body.

1700250.title: BAV
1700250.overview: BAV is a vibrant snapshot of college life capturing the chaos, raw immaturity, childlike energy, and unfiltered fun shared between students across three unforgettable years of their degree.

1700314.title: A Happy Family
1700314.overview: Niki has two kids, two jobs, and no money. After a fire turns her life upside down, her children are placed in foster care. Banned from contact, she assumes a new identity risking everything to stay close to them.

1702170.title: Monsieur Phil

1702298.title: Комнатное растение

1702490.title: No Way to Escape

1704090.title: Much About Love

1706074.title: Smile Charles

The painful gap between his inner emotions and his forced expressions breeds an unbearable awkwardness that severs him completely from the world. One day, Mari—a con artist who swindled 2 billion—pierces through the cracks of his isolated life. The uneasy companionship between the slick scammer and the awkward sex worker weaves through Bangkok's humid nights and Ayutthaya's silent ruins, leading Charles to confront the forgotten dreams and phantoms of his past.

1706714.title: The Secret Battlefield

Tasked with simulating a conflict against the United States, they confront harsh realities through intense analysis.

1706970.title: The Last Days of Napoléon
1706970.overview: It is a farewell story that focuses on the absolute loneliness Napoleon Bonaparte experienced during the final days of his life after being exiled to the island of Saint Helena, and his deep longing for his homeland.

1709914.title: Left Behind

1714714.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Reunion

Chris returns to Brooklyn for a special community event, only to find himself navigating old friendships, new responsibilities, and the same chaotic family energy he thought he’d outgrown. Blending nostalgia, humor, and modern-day challenges, the reunion brings the beloved characters back together for one unforgettable celebration.

1715482.title: Find Me, Okay?
1715482.overview: Saturday morning, Eden Yerushalmi and her best friend, Arbel, are dancing at the Nova Festival. Hours later, Eden is taken to Gaza while her sisters listen helplessly on the phone. What begins as a desperate hope for her return, becomes a journey through uncertainty, public struggle, and devastating loss. Through intimate access to Eden’s mother, sisters, and her best friend Arbel, Find Me, Okay?, follows the fight to bring Eden Yerushalmi home, the moment hope collapses, and the painful attempt to rebuild life afterward. A two-year portrait of love, grief, resilience, and the impossible task of moving forward after trauma.

Things change when he meets Marija, a high society college student, with whom he starts a whirlwind romance with, gaining a whole new world of possibilities in the process. But, as time goes on, his facade begins to slip away and Vigo is forced to get into increasingly deeper criminal waters to sustain his image.

It's enough for the Founding Fathers to be rolling in their graves, literally.

From their new home in France, Nathan and Nicole began pairing these recordings with footage of the birds and life around them.

1733402.title: My සිම්බා
1733402.overview: My සිම්බා (My Simba, 2026) is a heartwarming Sri Lankan Sinhala forest adventure directed and written by Janardhanan Krishnamoorthy (JK), marking a unique milestone as the first local feature film to star a live, real-life lion. The emotional narrative follows an innocent villager and his young son who unknowingly rescue an orphaned lion cub, raising it as part of their own family. As the cub grows into a majestic predator and the truth about its origins comes to light, the family is forced to navigate danger and sacrifice in a touching journey of love, courage, and the call of the wild. Releasing in theaters on July 17, 2026, the film features a strong ensemble cast led by Kalana Gunasekara, Roshan Ranawana, Nayomi Thakshila, and Suraj Mapa, alongside Rajitha Hiran and Meenuka Premarathna.
1733402.trailerName: My Simba (මයි සිම්බා) - Official Trailer - Kalana Gunasekara, Roshan Ranawana, Nayomi Thakshila, JK

1743514.title: Rescue
1743514.overview: On a dead-calm morning in the Mediterranean, the migrant rescue ship of Doctors Without Borders spots a deflating rubber boat. Dozens of people are struggling in the water. Among the refugees is Roro, a Yemeni mother traveling with her husband, Hani, their two-month-old baby, and two young sons. As the rescue begins, a Libyan militia intervenes and abducts Roro and the children, dragging them back to Libya. Meanwhile, Hani is rescued and arrives in Europe alone. A family is violently torn apart across the Mediterranean. While Hani fights from Europe to reunite the family, Roro struggles to survive captivity in Libya and to protect her children. Trapped by a violent system deeply entangled with EU border politics, she relentlessly attempts to cross the sea again. RESCUE is a gripping story of survival and injustice, and a powerful portrait of a young mother whose strength drives the film.

1777690.title: One More Spin

In their minds, the quiet between them fills with a rapid montage of imagined encounters—from instant chemistry to comedic disasters, heartfelt confessions to utterly bizarre twists. We see each version through both sets of eyes, revealing how differently two people can overthink the same moment. As the dryer stops and reality returns, they are faced with the decision to finally make a move.
